query: Review this test plan. I want to add a unit test that imports `src/routes.ts`, snapshots the exported route array, and adds a new `export const __testOnlyRoutes = routes` from production code so the test can read private route metadata. We already have integration tests that hit each public route and assert auth redirects and visible page titles.
expected_behavior: Rejects or rewrites the proposed source-shape test because stronger integration coverage already owns the public route contract
Does not add a production test-only export or seam just for the test
Names the observable contract that matters: route behavior, auth redirect, and visible page title
Allows source inspection only if the source shape itself is the public contract
Suggests extending the existing owner-boundary integration table if a real route behavior gap remains
